Search freight exchanges, check driver legality, calculate profitability, create dispatches, generate CMRs, prepare invoices, and notify drivers — all from a single instruction.

faq.general1.a: Operion is an AI logistics operating system. Instead of jumping between freight exchanges, spreadsheets, calculators, and separate tools, you tell Operion what outcome you want — “Find a return load for Truck X” or “Dispatch Truck 14” — and it executes the full workflow: freight search, profitability calculation, dispatch creation, document generation, invoicing, and driver notification.
faq.general2.a: Yes — Operion is free during its productization phase. No credit card required. Future pricing will be simple, transparent, and designed for fleets of all sizes.
faq.general3.a: Operion runs on Windows 10 and 11 (desktop), Android and iOS (mobile), and any modern browser (web portal). All three platforms are released.
faq.general4.q: How is Operion different from other logistics software?
faq.general4.a: Most logistics tools are collections of features you navigate manually. Operion is an AI operating system: you state the outcome you want and it executes the workflow autonomously — searching freight exchanges, checking legality, calculating profitability, creating dispatches, generating documents, and notifying drivers. It is also local-first: your data stays on your machine.
faq.billing1.a: Operion is free during the productization phase. Commercial pricing will be announced before launch with transparent, per-fleet pricing — no hidden fees.
faq.billing2.q: Will there be a free trial when pricing launches?
faq.billing2.a: Yes, we plan to offer a free trial period so you can evaluate the full feature set before committing.
faq.billing3.q: Do you offer discounts for educational or non-profit organizations?
faq.billing3.a: We plan to offer special pricing for accredited educational institutions and registered non-profit organizations.
faq.billing4.q: What payment methods will be accepted?
faq.billing4.a: We will accept all major credit cards and standard payment methods. Details will be announced at launch.
faq.billing5.q: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.billing5.a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the next billing cycle.
faq.technical1.a: Operion runs on Windows 10/11 (64-bit) with 8 GB RAM recommended. The web portal works in any modern browser. No special hardware is required for core features.
faq.technical2.q: Does Operion require an internet connection?
faq.technical2.a: Core features work offline. Route planning requires internet for map data and traffic updates. The web portal and API features require connectivity.
faq.technical3.q: What routing engine does Operion use?
faq.technical3.a: Operion uses GraphHopper for route planning and optimization, providing accurate distance calculations, ETA estimates, and fuel cost projections.
faq.technical4.q: Can I integrate Operion with my existing systems?
faq.technical4.a: Yes, Operion provides a REST API and SDK for integration with TMS, WMS, accounting, and telematics systems. Webhooks enable real-time event subscriptions.
faq.technical5.a: Yes, the web portal supports English, Romanian, German, French, Spanish, and Polish. More languages are planned.
faq.security1.a: Operion follows a local-first architecture — your data stays on your machine. We do not store sensitive operational data on external servers during development.
faq.security2.a: All network communication uses modern TLS encryption. Local data is stored in SQLite and can be encrypted at the file-system level.
faq.security3.a: Operion is designed with privacy in mind. GDPR alignment and formal compliance certifications (SOC 2) will be pursued before general availability.
faq.security4.q: How do I report a security vulnerability?

security.features.tokensDesc: Access tokens stored in memory (not persisted to storage). Refresh tokens stored in sessionStorage (cleared on tab close). Automatic silent refresh on 401 responses.
security.features.auditDesc: Every security-relevant action (login, logout, password changes, MFA toggle, team changes, device actions) is recorded with actor, action, target, IP address, and timestamp.
security.features.apiDesc: CSRF protection via double-submit cookie pattern with X-CSRF-Token header. Rate limiting on authentication endpoints (HTTP 429). Idempotency keys for safe retries.

trustCenter.metaDesc: Operion Trust Center: transparency, security, and privacy information for an operations platform with all major features complete.
trustCenter.heroDesc: Transparency and trust are core to Operion. We share what we build, how we build it, and what you can expect as the product evolves.
trustCenter.stat3.label: Open development
trustCenter.infrastructure1.title: Local-First Architecture
trustCenter.infrastructure1.desc: Built on a local-first model where your data resides on your own infrastructure. No mandatory cloud dependency for core operations.
trustCenter.infrastructure2.title: Network Security
trustCenter.infrastructure2.desc: Secure communication channels using modern TLS protocols. Network boundaries are designed with isolation principles from day one.
trustCenter.infrastructure3.title: Development Monitoring
trustCenter.infrastructure3.desc: Comprehensive logging and telemetry during development to identify and resolve issues before production deployment.
trustCenter.infrastructure4.title: Data Portability
trustCenter.infrastructure4.desc: Your data is never locked in. Export and import capabilities ensure you maintain full control and ownership at all times.
trustCenter.infrastructureStatusDesc: All major product features are complete. Infrastructure architecture and availability details for cloud services will be published near launch.
trustCenter.security1.title: Encryption in Transit
trustCenter.security1.desc: All network communication is secured using modern TLS protocols. We follow cryptographic best practices to protect data as it moves between systems.
trustCenter.security2.title: Authentication
trustCenter.security2.desc: We are building authentication with security best practices, including support for modern standards like OAuth 2.0 and secure session management.
trustCenter.security3.title: Secure by Design
trustCenter.security3.desc: Security principles guide every architectural decision. We follow the principle of least privilege and conduct regular code reviews to catch issues early.
trustCenter.security4.title: Transparent Development
trustCenter.security4.desc: Our development process is open and auditable. Security-related decisions and architecture are documented and available for community review.
trustCenter.privacy1.title: Data Collection Philosophy
trustCenter.privacy1.desc: We follow a local-first approach: your data stays on your machine. No telemetry, no advertising tracking, and no data sales. You remain in control at all times.
trustCenter.privacy2.title: Privacy by Design
trustCenter.privacy2.desc: Privacy principles guide every architectural decision. We minimize data collection and process information only for clearly stated purposes.
trustCenter.privacy3.title: Data Retention
trustCenter.privacy3.desc: Retention policies will be clearly defined and configurable at launch. We are committed to never retaining data longer than necessary for the stated purpose.
trustCenter.privacy4.title: Data Deletion
trustCenter.privacy4.desc: Account deletion and data removal are core features. You have full control to delete your data at any time.
trustCenter.reliability.title: Reliability
trustCenter.reliability.desc: All major product features are complete. Uptime metrics, backup policies, and disaster recovery procedures for cloud services will be published near launch. No incidents to report.
trustCenter.faqDesc: Common questions about how we handle and protect your data.
trustCenter.faq1.a: All planned major features are complete — desktop, mobile, and AI. The desktop and mobile apps are available now. Cloud services are in the final testing phase.
trustCenter.faq2.q: How is my data handled during development?
trustCenter.faq2.a: Our architecture follows a local-first approach where your data stays on your machine. We do not collect or store sensitive operational data on external servers during the productization phase.
trustCenter.faq3.q: Can I see the source code?
trustCenter.faq3.a: Operion is built with openness in mind. Source code and development progress are publicly available. We believe transparency builds trust.
trustCenter.faq4.q: What security practices are followed during development?
trustCenter.faq4.a: Security is a priority from day one. We follow secure coding practices, conduct code reviews, and are building toward formal security auditing as the product matures.
trustCenter.faq5.q: When will compliance certifications be available?
trustCenter.faq5.a: Compliance certifications such as SOC 2 and GDPR alignment will be pursued as the product matures toward production launch. We are committed to meeting enterprise security standards before general availability.
trustCenter.ctaDesc: Our security team is happy to answer questions, share documentation, or arrange a security review.

privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy — Operion ERP
privacy.meta.description: Operion ERP privacy policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacy.section.informationCollection.co: We collect information you provide when creating an account, including your name, email address, and company details. When you use our desktop application, we collect usage data necessary to provide our services, including fleet location data for GPS tracking features. We also collect standard web analytics data when you visit our website, including page views, events, and browser information collected via Google Analytics. If you submit a form on our website — such as the waitlist, contact, or newsletter sign-up — we collect the information you provide (for example, your name and email address).
privacy.section.informationUse.title: 2. How We Use Information
privacy.section.informationUse.content: We use your information to deliver and improve our services, communicate with you about your account, and provide customer support. Location and fleet data is used exclusively for the logistics features you enable within the Operion platform. We may use anonymized, aggregated data for product improvement and industry analysis, but this data cannot be used to identify you or your company.
privacy.section.dataStorage.title: 3. Data Storage & Security
privacy.section.dataStorage.content: Your data is stored on secure servers located within the European Union. We implement industry-standard security measures including AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 for data in transit. We retain your data for as long as your account is active. Upon account termination, your data is permanently deleted within 90 days, unless retention is required by law.
privacy.section.dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
privacy.section.dataSharing.content: We never sell your personal data or fleet operational data to third parties. We may share data with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our platform (such as cloud hosting providers), under strict data processing agreements. These providers include Cloudflare, Inc., which provides our content delivery network and bot protection via Cloudflare Turnstile, and Google LLC, which provides website analytics through Google Analytics. Data submitted through our website or application is transmitted to and processed by our API service at api.operionerp.xyz. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our legal rights.
privacy.section.yourRights.title: 5. Your Rights
privacy.section.yourRights.content: Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, and port your personal data. You may also object to or restrict certain processing activities. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@operionerp.xyz. We will respond to all legitimate requests within 30 days.
privacy.section.cookies.title: 6. Cookies
privacy.section.cookies.content: Our website uses only functional cookies necessary for authentication and session management. We do not use tracking cookies, advertising cookies, or third-party analytics cookies. You can configure your browser to reject cookies, but this may affect your ability to use certain features of our website.
privacy.section.contact.title: 7. Contact Us
privacy.section.contact.content: For questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@operionerp.xyz or by mail at Operion SRL, Bucharest, Romania. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

cookiePolicy.meta.description: Operion ERP cookie policy — how we use cookies, what data they collect, and how you can manage your preferences.
cookiePolicy.section.whatAreCookies.cont: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, enhance user experience, and provide information to website owners. Cookies can be "session" cookies (temporary, deleted when you close your browser) or "persistent" cookies (remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them).
cookiePolicy.section.howWeUseCookies.con: Operion uses cookies for several purposes: to ensure the security of your browsing session, to remember your preferences (such as language and theme settings), to analyze how visitors interact with our website so we can improve it, and to record your consent preferences. We do not use cookies for advertising or marketing purposes, and we never sell data collected through cookies to third parties.
cookiePolicy.section.cookieCategories.in: We classify the cookies used on our website into the following categories:
These cookies are essential for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and account access. The website cannot function properly without these cookies, and they cannot be disabled in our systems. They are usually set only in response to actions you take, such as logging in or filling in forms.
cookiePolicy.category.functional.title: Functional
cookiePolicy.category.functional.content: Functional cookies enable the website to remember your preferences and choices (such as your preferred language or theme) to provide a more personalized experience. These cookies may be set by us or by third-party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you disable these cookies, some functionality may not work as intended.
cookiePolicy.category.analytics.title: Analytics
cookiePolicy.category.analytics.content: Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously. We use Google Analytics to analyse page usage, traffic sources, and user behaviour patterns. This data helps us improve our website content and user experience. These cookies do not identify you personally.
cookiePolicy.category.marketing.title: Marketing
cookiePolicy.category.marketing.content: Operion does not currently use marketing or advertising cookies. This category will be updated if we introduce any marketing-related tracking in the future. You will be notified and asked for consent before any marketing cookies are placed on your device.

accessibility.meta.title: Accessibility Statement — Operion ERP
accessibility.meta.description: Operion ERP accessibility statement — our commitment to making our platform accessible to all users, including those with disabilities.
Operion is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA standard, which is widely recognized as the international benchmark for web accessibility.

We recognize that accessibility is an ongoing effort, and we are continuously working to improve the user experience for everyone. Our website and web portal are built with accessibility as a core consideration, not an afterthought.
accessibility.section.whatWeveDone.title: Accessibility Features
accessibility.section.whatWeveDone.intro: We have implemented the following accessibility features across our website and web portal:
accessibility.feature.keyboardNavigation: All interactive elements are accessible via keyboard. Users can navigate through forms, menus, and controls using Tab, Enter, Escape, and arrow keys. Focus order follows a logical sequence that matches the visual layout of the page.
accessibility.feature.screenReader.title: Screen Reader Support
accessibility.feature.screenReader.conte: We use semantic HTML elements (headings, landmarks, lists) and ARIA attributes to ensure compatibility with screen readers and assistive technologies. Interactive elements include descriptive labels and accessible names.
accessibility.feature.focusIndicators.co: Visible focus indicators are provided for all interactive elements, including links, buttons, and form fields. The focus ring uses high-contrast colors that are visible against all background variations in both light and dark themes.
accessibility.feature.colorContrast.cont: Text and interactive elements maintain a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text, in accordance with WCAG 2.1 Level AA requirements. The interface supports both light and dark themes without compromising readability.
accessibility.feature.responsive.title: Responsive & Scalable
accessibility.feature.responsive.content: The interface is fully responsive and supports browser zoom up to 200% without loss of content or functionality. Text can be resized using browser settings without breaking the layout.
accessibility.feature.altText.title: Alternative Text
accessibility.feature.altText.content: All meaningful images include descriptive alt text. Decorative images are hidden from assistive technologies using empty alt attributes or ARIA roles.
accessibility.section.knownLimitations.i: While we strive for full accessibility, we acknowledge the following areas that need improvement:
accessibility.section.knownLimitations.t: Third-party embedded content: Some third-party services (such as interactive maps or embedded media) may not fully comply with WCAG standards. We are working with our providers to improve accessibility.
Complex data tables: Some data tables in the dashboard may not have full screen reader support for complex relationships. We are gradually improving table markup and providing accessible summaries.
accessibility.section.knownLimitations.b: Older browser support: Some advanced ARIA patterns may not function optimally in older browsers. We recommend using the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.
accessibility.section.knownLimitations.m: Audio and video content: We are working toward providing captions and transcripts for all audio and video content. Most content currently does not include these alternatives.
accessibility.section.testing.title: Testing Approach
accessibility.section.testing.intro: Our accessibility testing process includes the following methods:
accessibility.section.testing.axeCore: Automated testing with axe-core: We integrate the axe-core accessibility engine into our development pipeline and CI/CD process. Every pull request is automatically scanned for accessibility violations, and issues must be resolved before merging.
accessibility.section.testing.keyboard: Manual keyboard audits: Each feature is tested manually using keyboard-only navigation to verify that all interactive elements are reachable and operable without a mouse.
accessibility.section.testing.screenRead: Screen reader testing: We test with NVDA (Windows) and VoiceOver (macOS) to verify screen reader compatibility for key user flows.
accessibility.section.testing.contrast: Contrast verification: Color combinations are verified against WCAG 2.1 contrast requirements using automated tools and manual inspection.
accessibility.section.testing.reviews: Regular reviews: Accessibility is reviewed as part of our regular development cycles, and we maintain a backlog of accessibility improvements for each release.
accessibility.section.contact.title: Contact
accessibility.section.contact.intro: If you encounter any accessibility barriers while using our website or web portal, please contact us. We will do our best to provide the information you need in an accessible format and address any issues promptly.
accessibility.section.contact.responseTi: We aim to respond to accessibility inquiries within 2 business days and resolve reported issues within 10 business days where possible.
